description: TS2322 inside an object literal (a value not enclosed by any named symbol). The exact P0 case where a repair must ground on the whole declaration, not the partial `count:` line.

expected.note: The object property `count: "hello"` violates the declared `count: number`. It has no enclosing named symbol, so the repair must ground on the whole `export const settings = {…}` declaration (evidence.enclosingRange), never the partial line.
